entities.summary: Gottfried Prinz zu Hohenlohe-Waldenburg-Schillingfürst, Ratibor und Corvey, was an Austro-Hungarian army officer and diplomat during World War I. He was the grandson of Princess Carolyne zu Sayn-Wittgenstein.
